title: A Simple and Rapid System for DNA and RNA Isolation from Diverse Plants Using Handmade Kit
protocol: Add CTAB, EDTA, Tris base, and NaCl to 100 ml autoclaved water to make the extraction buffer.
Gradually dissolve the components of the extraction buffer by shaking at room temperature.
Add βME to 1 ml of the extraction buffer before use for tissues with high polysaccharides and secondary metabolites.
Add PVPP to 1 ml of the extraction buffer only for tissues with high polyphenolic pollution.
Grind samples using 1 ml of the extraction buffer in a mortar and pestle that are sterilized.
Transfer the resulting solution to a sterile centrifuge tube.
Mix the sample by briefly vortexing until thoroughly resuspended.
Incubate samples at 65°C for 10 min for lysing cells completely.
Add chloroform: isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to each tube and homogenize them by vortexing.
Centrifuge at 13700 g at 4°C for 10 min.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new tube (size= 1.5 ml).
Add 700 µl of cold isopropanol to precipitate RNA or DNA and then invert tubes 3-4 times to mix the solution.
Centrifuge tubes at 13700 g at 4°C for 10 min.
Discard the supernatant and wash the precipitate nucleic acid gently with 70% EtOH.
After centrifuging at 5400 g at 4°C for 5 min, remove the supernatant and then air-dry the pellet.
Dissolve the pellet in 20-30 µl of RNase free water (commercial) or autoclaved water.
Incubate at room temperature for a few minutes.
Keep the solubilized nucleic acid in −20°C for short-term storage or in −80°C for long-term storage.
